full_script: Let me educate you free of charge: hard work without strategic positioning is just organized suffering. You wake up at four in the morning to carry heavy cement blocks on your head, and you boast: 'I am a hardworking man.' Nobody pays for your perspiration; the world only compensates you for your economic leverage. A wheelbarrow pusher works ten times harder than the bank manager in an air-conditioned office. If hard work alone produced wealth, the donkey should be the chief executive officer of the kingdom. You must transition from muscle power to intellectual leverage. Stop breaking your spine for minimum wage and start constructing perceived value. Adaptability is the real currency of life. Humble yourself to acquire high-value information, and see how fast your trajectory changes. Prof Layi has spoken.
